Its flaws are small: the circle crowds 'Full review inside.', and that line sits tight to the bottom edge. B's NEW VIDEO badge is clipped at the right edge of the canvas. Its headline is smaller and 'marathons' almost touches the circle, while a large empty band sits below the small closing line, so the spacing is cramped at the top and dead at the bottom.
